proposed_facts.reason: The predicate tests only 0x14D and 0x14E, mapped by the motion table to CaptureLeadead and CaptureLikelike. The enemy-qualified name meaningfully improves the rendered generic capture name; the rationale explicitly preserves its two-state scope rather than implying recognition of every capture.

Canonical equations use the incoming XYZ magnitude and unnormalized supplied XY components, with a tiny nonzero quarter-turn approximation term. Output Z is zero and zero direction clears all components. The cited ReDead caller supplies velocity, floor normal, and facing. Conditional approximate speed preservation corrects the existing overstatement and matches functionality.md.
